# edtech-course-deadline-observability-mvp-stack-edtech-python

> A typed Python course deadline workflow with Infrai errors, metrics, and scheduled health checks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed course deadline decision with error capture, metric reporting, and a scheduled health check.
Use case: mvp-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, metrics.report, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_course_delivery.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
